# L2′ — Alchemical-Elemental

**MEF lens `L2′`** · Square C — Becoming `[2 + 3]`: logic ⇄ process, synchronic ⇄ diachronic · Night face · index `#2′` · tonic `F` · ground-pair **Sacrifice** (Power-led) · twin: [L2 — Logical](L2-logical.md)

*Root:* alchemy, transcendent function · *Element:* Aether (the element root) · *Möbius:* `L2′ → L3` · THE ELEMENT-BEARING LENS

The same Word/Sacrifice rotation grounded on the Power-face: not the logic of the cut but its *transformative cost* — *solve et coagula*. Assigns elemental charges to all coordinates.

## Sublens

The six inner sublenses, each tagged with its rotated `Name[note]` / `Power[note]` (chromatic-basis note-tags):

- **L2.0′ — Aether** (`Sacrifice[F]` / `Word[E]`) — the quintessence; *prima materia* and *ultima materia*, the psychoid ground of transformation.

- **L2.1′ — Earth** (`Decision[G]` / `Logos[F♯]`) — solidity, form; the *corpus*, the *nigredo*, the fixed principle.

- **L2.2′ — Water** (`Love[A]` / `Son[G♯]`) — fluidity, dissolution, feeling; the *solutio*, the unconscious.

- **L2.3′ — Air** (`Work[B]` / `Image[A♯]`) — thought, breath, connection; the *sublimatio*, the volatile.

- **L2.4′ — Fire** (`Play[C♯]` / `Truth[C]`) — transmutation, energy, will; the *calcinatio*, burning away the inessential.

- **L2.5′ — Salt** (`Need[D♯]` / `Mind[D]`) — the *lapis*, earth transformed through all elements; the fixed body of the work, matter perfected. *(Formerly tabulated as Mineral.)*


## Derivation at this index

*Shares `L2`'s 8-fold and diatonic* — sounding Logos·Son·Image·Truth + Decision·Love·Work·Play; anchors Word, Mind, Sacrifice, Need; diatonic Word–Logos–Son · Love–Work–Play–Need.

*Reading:* grounded on Sacrifice, transformation is read as elemental opus — dissolution and re-gathering crystallising as Salt; the Name hexad (Word→Mind) is the articulable form the opus fixes.
